<thought>Using the ESI‑MS data, the base peak at m/z 276.0666 likely corresponds to [M+H]⁺. Subtracting the proton mass gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈275.059 Da. The isotopic pattern shows a strong M+2 peak (~33 %) characteristic of one chlorine atom, and the M+1 intensity (~16 %) matches ~14–15 carbons (≈1.1 % per ¹³C). Solving 12 C + 1.007825 H + 15.994915 O + 34.968852 (Cl) ≈ 275.059 Da yields the composition C₁₅H₁₂O₃Cl, which fits the mass within experimental tolerance and gives a reasonable DBE (10). Therefore the molecular formula is C15H12O3Cl.</thought>
<final_answer>C15H12O3Cl</final_answer>
